leads.name: The Millennial Olives of Vila Fresca de Azeitao
leads.update_2026-10-29: Delivered as stb_011 in data/research/setubal-verified.json, flagged: parish council confirms location and 'about 2,000 years per some specialists', 2016 blog describes roadside plaque; access still not stated by a source, life check NONE.
leads.why: Three olives classified in 1959, decades before anything in the centre, with girths of 7.60m, 5.25m and 5.24m, so by far the largest trees in the municipality and claimed at roughly 2,000 years. Three blockers, all solvable: access is unconfirmed (they stand by the EN10 at Quinta Velha and no source says whether a visitor may approach, so hard rule 10's leave-it-out applies), the register's age field is corrupt for all three (it reads 2009, a year in an age column), and the 2,000-year claim needs checking against Portugal's other olive claims under hard rule 8. About 10 km west, within the day-trip boundary by TST bus. If access confirms, these beat everything on the published page.

leads.name: The Centenarian Magnolias of Avenida Luisa Todi
leads.why: Named in local press as centenarian and proposed for classification but not yet classified, with white scented flowers in spring. They stand on the main central avenue, squarely inside the existing walk, so they would strengthen it rather than extend it. Failed only on the evidence bar: no register entry and press as the single source.

leads.name: KNJ1/520, the smaller silky oak
leads.why: Already published: folded into stb_003 ("The Silky Oaks of Largo Marques de Pombal"), whose story explicitly covers both trees ('there are two of them here'). Registered separately (KNJ1/520) but standing metres from its twin and distinguished only by girth, so it was deliberately given no pin of its own. Same for KNJ1/524 (stone pine) and KNJ1/527 (black poplar): three registered trees folded into their siblings' pages to avoid near-identical entries. Marked 'folded' 2026-08-23 after leads.py's READY check surfaced this as needing a story, which it does not: the status field just hadn't been updated when the folding decision was made.

leads.name: Sequoia of Parque do Bonfim
leads.why: 2026-10-31 pass: municipal candidacy (semmais.pt 2020-06-06) gives 95 years, not classified; Camara Tree Tag release (noticias.mun-setubal.pt, 2025) tags one and calls it unique in the concelho, so it was alive in 2025. No coordinate, no measurement, no tree-level photo (Commons geosearch near 38.529,-8.891 finds only park views); the park is not a small site. No photo or exact pin in reach. A 95-year-old sequoia is not ancient on its own.

leads.name: Magnolia of Avenida Luisa Todi (Tree Tag)
leads.why: 2026-10-31 pass: second source now exists. Camara Tree Tag release (2025) tags one magnolia on Avenida Luisa Todi (alive 2025); the candidacy gave two magnolias aged 93 and 95. Still no coordinate or measurement, an avenue median is not a small site, no photo. No photo or exact pin in reach.

leads.name: Linden, Norfolk Island hibiscus and Aleppo pine of Jardim do Quebedo
leads.species: Tilia sp.; Lagunaria patersonii; Pinus halepensis
leads.why: 2026-10-31 pass: candidacy ages 96, 92 and 90 years (semmais.pt 2020); Tree Tag 2025 tags the linden. Garden centred near 38.525,-8.887 (Praca do Quebedo); no per-tree coordinate, size or photo, which trunk is which unknown. Lagunaria already ours as stb_007.

leads.name: Bunya pine and plane of Parque do Bonfim; cedars of Avenida Frei Antonio das Chagas; weeping elm of Praca Teofilo Braga; cork oaks of Avenida Mestre Lima de Freitas and the two cemeteries (one over 200 years)
leads.why: 2026-10-31 pass: all named only in the 2020 municipal candidacy of 17 trees (semmais.pt), no coordinates, no measurements, classification status unconfirmed; Tree Tag 2025 tags a cedar at Rua Frei Antonio das Chagas, a cork oak at Avenida Mestre Lima de Freitas, an oak at Parque de Vanicelos and a eucalyptus at Parque Urbano de Albarquel. Needs the municipal map (setubalambiente.pt fails TLS from the runner, curl exit 60) for pins. The cemetery cork oak over 200 years is the one most worth a pin.

leads.name: Register rows 17 to 25 km out (unjudged)
leads.species: Phoenix dactylifera 1.1 m (38.65075,-9.00504); Dracaena draco 1.9 m (38.6442,-9.0932); Quercus ilex 7.3 m (38.637,-9.1377); Quercus suber 3.5 m (38.4794,-9.1402)
leads.why: 2026-10-31 pass: ICNF register rows only, beyond the 30-minute day-trip boundary or in other concelhos (Seixal, Almada, Sesimbra), no web source or life evidence found for the palm; the 7.3 m holm oak (Almada side, 24.5 km) is the one worth a Lisbon-area pass.

open_questions: The municipality counts 21 classified trees plus 14 newly proposed against the 16 our ICNF import holds for this concelho. Either the import misses rows or the municipality counts individuals where the register counts processos. Worth reconciling before Portugal's country page quotes any national total.

Setubal em Bom Ambiente (setubalambiente.pt) runs an interactive municipal tree map that the press says carries per-tree location, height, age and curiosidades. Untried. Worth one fetch next pass for both extra facts and any image licence.
